author: EkohsVT
title: VTuber brand art pack
content:
🚨 Hi everyone! 🚨 

 I’ve been on the lookout for artists to help flesh out my random Internet Doggo brand! I’d love for you all to help if possible! 

The rules are simple! Instead of self-promoting your own art and services, please recommend and advertise artists you love that have delivered for you or your friends; no gatekeeping allowed! This helps not only me, but everyone else find awesome artists who are trustworthy and not a heccin bot! 

I’ll only accept self-promotions from my artist friends and mutuals; all others I’ll likely ignore, so if you wanna self-promote, have someone recommend you! 

I want to keep a library of awesome peeps for commissions now and into the future! Here is what I’m currently after:

¤ Character Reference Art
¤ Skeb-style art
¤ Stream Scenes (Starting, BRB, Ending, other overlays?)
¤ Banner Art
¤ Twitch Panels
¤ Sub Badges
¤ Stingers
¤ Mascot Character PNGtuber for TTS

I look forward to working with anyone! If you could help share this, id greatly appreciate it as well! ^^

Thank you!
